scope: Targeted primary-source search, not an exhaustive systematic review or full reading of all user-listed papers.

references.title: 3DMambaComplete: Structured State Space Model for High-Efficiency Point Cloud Completion
references.access: Author-uploaded v2 method text inspected, especially Sections3.2–3.4; ACM page not independently inspected; code not inspected
references.finding: Generation includes multi-head cross-attention; hyperpoint generation and subsequent spread are related precedents. Original abs metadata has older title/authors; cite the version actually read.

references.title: CompletionMamba: Taming State Space Model for Point Cloud Completion
references.access: Author institutional publication record and abstract inspected; complete architecture/code not audited
references.finding: Local SSM and shape-aware information are prior work; does not establish fixed Sobol-probe generation or whole-network attention-free equivalence.

references.title: FusionMamba: Efficient 3D point cloud completion via spatially-aware state space models and multi-scale information fusion
references.access: Publisher abstract/highlights/introduction preview verified; complete equations and source unavailable/not audited
references.finding: LGSA and geometric residual alignment are nearby; cannot conclude that moving to first coarse alone avoids overlap.

references.title: GDPNet: A Geometry Aware Dual-Path Network for point cloud completion
references.access: Publisher abstract/introduction snippets inspected; complete KSM equation and linked anonymous code not verified
references.finding: Keynodes Shift generates coarse skeletons from input anchors; high conceptual overlap, exact equivalence unknown.

references.title: AnchorFormer: Point Cloud Completion From Discriminative Nodes
references.access: Official CVF search record/abstract and PDF extraction inspected; direct HTML returned403 on a later attempt; code not audited
references.finding: Input-derived regional anchors and offsets predate this plan; uses attention and a different completion task.

references.title: SeedFormer: Patch Seeds Based Point Cloud Completion with Upsample Transformer
references.access: Official ECVA abstract inspected; source not audited
references.finding: Patch-seed regional conditioning is established prior work, not an attention-free SPCG equivalent.

references.title: DAPointMamba: Domain Adaptive Point Mamba for Point Cloud Completion
references.finding: Patch scanning and spatial/channel SSM alignment target domain-adaptive completion, not this single-domain probe head.

references.title: Hyper-PCN: Hypergraph-Based Point Cloud Completion via High-Order Correlation Modeling
references.access: Official CVF search record/abstract and official repository README verified; direct paper access403; complete method/code not audited
references.finding: Anchor/hypergraph relation modeling is nearby; fixed Sobol-probe equivalence not established.

references.title: BuildingComSSSM: Building point cloud completion with Geometry-Aware Mambas
references.finding: Keypoint generation and diffusion use self-/cross-attention; not a fully attention-free construction to copy.

references.title: MedPCFM: Improving Medical Point Cloud Completion by Integrating Point Transformers and Flow Matching
references.finding: Kamil Kwarciak and Marek Wodzinski; PTv3 deterministic/FM medical baselines; sampling, cardinality, normalization and training differ from BCSP.

references.title: MedPCFM-TED: One-Step Point Cloud Flow Matching for Implant Generation via Teacher-Guided Endpoint Distillation
references.date: arXiv 2026-09-15; MICCAI2026 SASHIMI official open-access page
references.access: Official satellite-event abstract/page inspected; full paper/source not audited in this review
references.finding: One-step cranial implant generation is an additional recent task competitor; reported timing cannot be compared without matched hardware/protocol.

references.title: Plausible but Unimplantable: A Trustworthiness Audit of Shape Completion Foundation Models for Cranial Defect Reconstruction
references.date: arXiv2026-10-21; author reports ACCV2026 TrustFMI acceptance
references.access: Author preprint abstract and status inspected; full methods not independently reimplemented
references.finding: Visual plausibility and clinical implantability must be separated; selected zero-shot models do not imply all task-trained point models fail.

references.title: High-Resolution Cranial Defect Reconstruction by Iterative, Low-Resolution, Point Cloud Completion Transformers
references.finding: Cranial point completion and iterative resolution expansion provide medical context; not the same single-Native BCSP comparison.

references.title: SobolEngine
references.date: Official current PyTorch documentation; target runtime remains frozen project version
references.access: Official API inspected; attempted historical2.4 page/source unavailable in browser
references.finding: Stateful low-discrepancy sampler; generate a fresh256-point asset once in authorized compatible environment, freeze exact bytes. No library upgrade is implied.

references.title: Multi-Path Mamba Diffusion for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Scene Completion
references.finding: Recent Mamba semantic-scene completion; task is different and not a direct cranial implant baseline.
